description: Add one task to an existing project in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires signing in to LoopGantt, or an API key). Put it under a phase with parentId, make it wait for other tasks with dependencies, and hand it to a person with assigneeId or to a bot with agentLabel (e.g. "qa-bot"). Returns the new task id.

agentLabel.description: The bot (agent) that owns this task, e.g. "qa-bot" (1-64 characters) - so a team of agents can split one board. Use your own stable name. assigneeId is for a real PERSON; leave it alone unless a human should own the task.

assigneeId.description: User id of the project owner or an accepted member (a real person)

deadline.description: Finish-by date YYYY-MM-DD (a marker, not a constraint)

dependencies.description: Tasks (same project, not phases) this one waits for

type.description: FS (default): starts after the predecessor finishes

durationDays.description: Working days; 0 makes it a milestone

isPhase.description: Make it a phase that groups other tasks

parentId.description: Phase task id to put this task under

status.description: Workflow stage id - use one of the project's stage ids (list_projects shows each project's stages; any other value is stored as sent, shown in the board's first column, and warned about), e.g. not_started, in_progress, on_hold, completed, or todo, in_progress, blocked, waiting_approval, done on an agent board. Prefer complete_task for 'done'. Default: the first stage.

name: create_task
